description: Case 02 of the external suggestion: two columns written line by line at the same height, 8 lines each (3 are too few for the column detection, by design). Column A must be read whole before column B, and no two sentences may be glued without a space.
in_order: COLUNA A LINHA 1: o argumento começa aqui,
COLUNA A LINHA 8: o bloco que vem depois.
COLUNA B LINHA 1: o segundo bloco começa
COLUNA B LINHA 8: arquivo nesta página.
